text: María, an idle girl punished in an isolated Colony, [flees into the woods|trigger|running from trouble] and hides from a Wolf in an abandoned house, where two pigs welcome her. The house reshapes itself around her feelings, and the pigs [become humans she names Ana and Pedro|threat|the body turning monstrous], while the Wolf waits outside calling her home. As the food runs out, her new family grows hungry and secretive, and they [tie her to a bed|rules|trapped with no way out], [discussing their hunger over her|wants|feeding on the living].
